# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by web/scripts/gen-cli-docs.ts from `glot 0.4.0 --help`. Do not edit by hand: rerun the script. -->

Generated from the help of `glot 0.4.0`. Every command also prints this with `glot <command> --help`.

```text
Your coding agent localizes your app; deterministic code guarantees nothing broken or too long lands in your catalogs.

Usage: glot <COMMAND>

Start
  init        Detect the i18n stack, write glot.toml + rules for your coding agent
                $ glot init
  i18nize     Turn hardcoded UI strings into keys and rewrite the code
                $ glot i18nize --dry-run app/page.tsx
  translate   Translate missing/stale strings; invalid output is refused, retried, never written
                $ glot translate --locale fr,de --dry-run
  localize    All of the above in one idempotent step, then check
                $ glot localize --yes --targets fr,de
  docs        Translate Markdown / MDX pages whole ([[docs]]: Docusaurus, VitePress, Starlight, MkDocs, Hugo)
                $ glot docs --dry-run

Guarantees
  check       Validate every catalog: syntax, placeholders, CLDR plurals, glossary, width (CI)
                $ glot check --format github
  status      Coverage per locale, stale strings, hand edits protected by glot.lock
                $ glot status
  extract     Hardcoded strings in code, missing and unused keys
                $ glot extract
  set         Set a translation by hand (validated, then never overwritten)
                $ glot set de nav.billing "Abrechnung"
  add         Add or replace a source string
                $ glot add nav.billing "Billing" --note "sidebar link"
  glossary    Terms enforced by the validator (glossary.toml)
                $ glot glossary add Workspace --fr "Espace de travail"
  compile     gettext .po to .mo (+ WordPress script JSON), kept in sync afterwards
                $ glot compile

Pixel budgets
  measure     Record each key's box (width, lines, font) from the running app
                $ glot measure --base-url http://localhost:3000 --routes /,/billing
  fit         Shorten translations that overflow, re-render until they fit
                $ glot fit --base-url http://localhost:3000 --routes / --locales de

Your agent and your app
  mcp         MCP server: your coding agent reads keys, context and the glossary, adds strings
                $ claude mcp add glot -- glot mcp
  dev         Alt+click any text in the running app to edit it (validated)
                $ glot dev
  agent-prompt  Print a ready-to-paste i18n prompt for a coding agent or app builder
                $ glot agent-prompt
  provenance  Who/what produced each translation (model, date, reviewer), for AI-disclosure
                $ glot provenance export --format csv
  wif         Keyless Claude in CI (Workload Identity Federation): create issuer/rule, check a JWT
                $ glot wif rule create --preset github --repo acme/web --issuer fdis_… --service-account svac_… --workspace wrkspc_… --name glot-ci

Server (experimental)
  push, pull  Sync catalogs, lock and glossary with a self-hosted glot server
  annotations  What reviewers pinned on your site: list, reply, resolve, apply, review links
                $ glot annotations list --route /pricing --locale de
  experiments  Segmented copy experiments: push/pull glot.experiments.toml, status, promote
                $ glot experiments status hero-de --json

Labs
  labs        coverage, review, parity, seo, db, assets, unused, queue, tm, markets, store, distill, culture, panel, render:
              `glot labs --help`

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
```

## glot init

Detect the i18n stack and write glot.toml + AI agent integration

```text
Detect the i18n stack and write glot.toml + AI agent integration

Usage: glot init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --source <SOURCE>      Source locale (default: `en` if found, else the first detected locale)
      --targets <TARGETS>    Target locales, comma separated (default: other detected locales)
      --provider <PROVIDER>  LLM provider: anthropic | openai | openai-compatible | gemini (Gemini 3 Flash preset) | mock
  -y, --yes                  Accept detected defaults without prompting
      --force                Overwrite existing files
  -h, --help                 Print help
```

## glot i18nize

Convert hardcoded UI strings to translation keys and rewrite the code (next-intl / react-i18next)

```text
Convert hardcoded UI strings to translation keys and rewrite the code (next-intl / react-i18next)

Usage: glot i18nize [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  [PATHS]...
          Files or directories to convert (default: every file matched by `[extract].include`)

Options:
      --dry-run
          Show the diff and the keys that would be created; write nothing

  -y, --yes
          Do not ask for confirmation

      --lib <LIB>
          i18n library the rewritten code targets

          Possible values:
          - auto
          - next-intl
          - react-i18next
          - custom:        The app's own `t(key)` hook (hand-rolled LanguageContext / useLanguage)
          
          [default: auto]

      --routing <ROUTING>
          Next.js locale URLs: `cookie` (`/fr/...` selects and remembers the locale, no `app/[locale]` move) or `prefix` (non-default locales always under `/fr/...`)

          Possible values:
          - prefix: Non-default locales always live under `/fr/...` (`as-needed`: the default has no prefix)
          - cookie: `/fr/...` selects the locale and stores it in a cookie; unprefixed URLs keep it
          
          [default: cookie]

      --switcher
          Also generate a ready-to-use `<LocaleSwitcher />` component

      --no-install
          Do not run the package manager; print the install command instead

      --no-setup
          Only rewrite the code: do not wire the i18n library (provider, config, proxy)

      --rewrite
          Swift: also wrap plain `String`s shown to the user (UIKit `.text = "…"`) in `String(localized:)`

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## glot translate

Translate missing and stale strings with the configured LLM

```text
Translate missing and stale strings with the configured LLM

Usage: glot translate [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --locale <LOCALE>            Locales to translate (comma separated). Default: all targets
      --key <KEY>                  Only these keys (comma separated or repeated)
      --force                      Retranslate up-to-date and hand-edited entries too
      --dry-run                    Show the plan and estimated cost only
  -y, --yes                        Do not ask for confirmation
      --visual                     Capture the running app and show the LLM where each key renders (`--base-url`, `--routes`)
      --batch                      First pass through the Anthropic Message Batches API: -50 %, asynchronous (minutes to hours). Resumable: rerun the same command if interrupted
      --provider <PROVIDER>        LLM provider for this run, overriding glot.toml (`mock`: offline, free, no API key) [possible values: mock, anthropic, openai, openai-compatible]
      --base-url <BASE_URL>        Running app to capture [default: http://localhost:3000]
      --routes <ROUTES>            Routes to capture (comma separated) [default: /]
      --url-pattern <URL_PATTERN>  URL layout; the source locale gets no prefix [default: /{locale}{route}]
      --viewports <VIEWPORTS>      [default: 1280x800]
  -h, --help                       Print help
```

## glot localize

One step: init (if needed) → i18nize → translate → check → status. Idempotent

```text
One step: init (if needed) → i18nize → translate → check → status. Idempotent

Usage: glot localize [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --targets <TARGETS>    Target locales for a new project (comma separated), passed to `glot init`
      --dry-run              Show what each step would do (i18nize diff, translation plan and cost); write nothing
  -y, --yes                  Do not ask for confirmation
      --provider <PROVIDER>  LLM provider for this run (`mock`: offline, free, no API key) [possible values: mock, anthropic, openai, openai-compatible]
      --no-i18nize           Skip the code rewrite (strings already in catalogs)
      --no-install           Do not run the package manager (passed to `glot i18nize`); the install command is printed instead
      --print-agent-prompt   Print the agent prompt for this project and exit (like i18next-cli `--print-agent-prompt`)
  -h, --help                 Print help
```

## glot docs

Translate Markdown / MDX pages whole (`[[docs]]` in glot.toml): Docusaurus, VitePress, Starlight, MkDocs, Hugo, Jekyll

```text
Translate Markdown / MDX pages whole (`[[docs]]` in glot.toml): Docusaurus, VitePress, Starlight, MkDocs, Hugo, Jekyll

Usage: glot docs [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --dry-run              Show the plan (pages, segments, estimated cost); write nothing
  -y, --yes                  Do not ask for confirmation
```

## glot fit

Shorten translations that overflow in the running app, re-render, repeat until they fit

```text
Shorten translations that overflow in the running app, re-render, repeat until they fit

Usage: glot fit [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --base-url <BASE_URL>
          Running app to capture [default: http://localhost:3000]
      --routes <ROUTES>
          Routes to capture (comma separated) [default: /]
      --url-pattern <URL_PATTERN>
          URL layout; the source locale gets no prefix [default: /{locale}{route}]
      --viewports <VIEWPORTS>
          [default: 1280x800]
      --locales <LOCALES>
          Locales to fix (comma separated). Default: all targets
      --max-iterations <MAX_ITERATIONS>
          [default: 3]
  -y, --yes
          Write without asking
      --build-cmd <BUILD_CMD>
          Rebuild command run after each write (prod builds); dev servers just hot-reload
      --reload-ms <RELOAD_MS>
          Wait after writing before re-rendering (HMR / rebuild settle time) [default: 1500]
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## glot wif

Keyless Claude: Workload Identity Federation issuers, rules, and a local JWT check

```text
Keyless Claude: Workload Identity Federation issuers, rules, and a local JWT check

Usage: glot wif <COMMAND>

Commands:
  issuer  Federation issuers (the OIDC identity provider Anthropic trusts)
  rule    Federation rules (which JWTs may act as which service account)
  check   Decode a JWT locally (never sent) and compare it with an issuer + rule: iss, aud, sub, claims, exp/iat/lifetime, kid, alg. Exit 1 when a check fails
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

## glot wif issuer

Federation issuers (the OIDC identity provider Anthropic trusts)

```text
Federation issuers (the OIDC identity provider Anthropic trusts)

Usage: glot wif issuer <COMMAND>

Commands:

  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

  -h, --help  Print help
```

## glot wif issuer create

Register an issuer (POST /v1/organizations/federation_issuers)

```text
Register an issuer (POST /v1/organizations/federation_issuers)

Usage: glot wif issuer create [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --preset <PRESET>
          Possible values:
          - github: GitHub Actions: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com, discovery, repo-pinned subject

      --name <NAME>
          Slug `^[a-z0-9-]+$` (github preset: github-actions)

      --issuer-url <ISSUER_URL>
          Exact `iss` claim value

      --jwks <JWKS>
          Inferred from --jwks-url (explicit-url) or --jwks-file / --jwks-from (inline); default discovery

          Possible values:
          - discovery:    OIDC discovery (GitHub Actions, EKS, GKE, Entra ID…)
          - explicit-url: Fixed JWKS URL (internal discovery, public JWKS)
          - inline:       Upload the keys (self-hosted / air-gapped Kubernetes). No auto-refresh

      --discovery-base <DISCOVERY_BASE>
          Discovery document base, when it differs from the issuer URL

      --jwks-url <JWKS_URL>
          JWKS endpoint (explicit-url)

      --jwks-file <JWKS_FILE>
          Local JWKS file; its `keys` array is uploaded (inline)

      --jwks-from <JWKS_FROM>
          Download this JWKS now and upload its keys (inline)

      --ca-cert <CA_CERT>
          PEM file of a private CA for the JWKS fetch (discovery / explicit-url)

      --no-check-jti
          Disable jti single-use (replay protection) for every rule on this issuer. Last resort

      --max-lifetime <MAX_LIFETIME>
          Max JWT lifetime (exp - iat) accepted, seconds (default 3600)

      --dry-run
          Print the request body instead of calling the API

      --base-url <BASE_URL>
          API base URL (default: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, else https://api.anthropic.com)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## glot wif rule create

Create a rule (POST /v1/organizations/federation_rules)

```text
Create a rule (POST /v1/organizations/federation_rules)

Usage: glot wif rule create [OPTIONS] --name <NAME> --issuer <ISSUER> --service-account <SERVICE_ACCOUNT>

Options:
      --name <NAME>
          Slug `^[a-z0-9-]+$`

      --issuer <ISSUER>
          Issuer id (fdis_…)

      --service-account <SERVICE_ACCOUNT>
          Target service account (svac_…)

      --workspace <WORKSPACE>
          Workspace the minted tokens bill to (wrkspc_…)

      --all-workspaces
          

      --preset <PRESET>
          Possible values:
          - github: GitHub Actions: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com, discovery, repo-pinned subject

      --repo <REPO>
          github preset: OWNER/REPO (subject `repo:OWNER/REPO:*` + repository_owner claim)

      --ref <GIT_REF>
          github preset: pin a git ref (claims.ref), e.g. refs/heads/main. Omit for pull_request runs

      --subject-prefix <SUBJECT_PREFIX>
          `sub` match: exact, or prefix with a trailing `*`

      --audience <AUDIENCE>
          Exact `aud` (github preset: https://api.anthropic.com)

      --claim <CLAIMS>
          Exact claim match, repeatable: --claim ref=refs/heads/main

      --condition <CONDITION>
          CEL condition over `claims`, e.g. 'claims.ref in ["refs/heads/main"]'

      --scope <SCOPE>
          workspace:inference (Messages + Models, enough for glot) or workspace:developer
          
          [default: workspace:inference]

      --token-lifetime <TOKEN_LIFETIME>
          Access-token lifetime, 60–86400 s (server default 3600)

      --dry-run
          Print the request body instead of calling the API

      --base-url <BASE_URL>
          API base URL (default: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, else https://api.anthropic.com)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## glot wif check

Decode a JWT locally (never sent) and compare it with an issuer + rule: iss, aud, sub, claims, exp/iat/lifetime, kid, alg. Exit 1 when a check fails

```text
Decode a JWT locally (never sent) and compare it with an issuer + rule: iss, aud, sub, claims, exp/iat/lifetime, kid, alg. Exit 1 when a check fails

Usage: glot wif check [OPTIONS] [JWT]

Arguments:
  [JWT]
          JWT file, or `-` for stdin (default: ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE)

Options:
      --preset <PRESET>
          Possible values:
          - github: GitHub Actions: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com, discovery, repo-pinned subject

      --repo <REPO>
          github preset: OWNER/REPO (subject `repo:OWNER/REPO:*` + repository_owner claim)

      --ref <GIT_REF>
          github preset: pin a git ref (claims.ref), e.g. refs/heads/main. Omit for pull_request runs

      --subject-prefix <SUBJECT_PREFIX>
          `sub` match: exact, or prefix with a trailing `*`

      --audience <AUDIENCE>
          Exact `aud` (github preset: https://api.anthropic.com)

      --claim <CLAIMS>
          Exact claim match, repeatable: --claim ref=refs/heads/main

      --issuer-url <ISSUER_URL>
          Expected `iss` (github preset: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com)

      --max-lifetime <MAX_LIFETIME>
          Issuer max JWT lifetime, seconds (default 3600)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## glot annotations

Live-review annotations from the site: list, reply, resolve, apply suggestions, share a review link

```text
Live-review annotations from the site: list, reply, resolve, apply suggestions, share a review link

Usage: glot annotations <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list     Annotations reviewers pinned on the site (default: open + in progress)
  show     One annotation with its thread, code usages and screenshots
  add      Annotate a key from the terminal
  reply    Reply in the thread
  resolve  Mark resolved (`-m`: say what you changed, posted in the thread first)
  reopen   Reopen
  apply    Write the suggestion (or `--value`) as the validated translation, locally and on the server; resolves it
  rewrite  Ask the project LLM for rewordings (every locale, validated); `--pick N` writes proposal N
  link     Create a shareable review link for a reviewer without an account
  github   Mirror an annotation to GitHub: an issue in the linked repo, or `--pr` a comment on the open glot PR
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

## glot experiments promote

```text
Promote a variant everywhere (official translation) or for its segment (served by the edge), then offer to test its translation in the other languages (`--propagate` does it in the same command)

Usage: glot experiments promote [OPTIONS] <EXPERIMENT>

Arguments:
  <EXPERIMENT>  

Options:
      --arm <ARM>      Winning arm (default: the winner the server declared)
      --scope <SCOPE>  `all`: write it as the official translation (history, lockfile on the next `glot pull`); `segment`: keep serving it to that segment only (permanent personalization) [default: all] [possible values: all, segment]

  -y, --yes            No confirmation prompt
```

## glot labs

Experimental commands outside the core loop (the old `glot <cmd>` spelling still works)

```text
Experimental commands outside the core loop (the old `glot <cmd>` spelling still works)

Usage: glot labs <COMMAND>

Commands:
  coverage  Plural/select branch coverage per locale and CLDR category (`--render`: check each branch in a browser)
  review    Back-translate translations and explain them; `--stale` sorts cosmetic vs real source changes
  parity    Task parity: an agent runs the same tasks in every locale (glot.tasks.yaml) and compares success
  seo       Multilingual SEO: audit hreflang/canonical/metadata per locale, fix Next.js, localize keywords
  db        Translate database content (catalog, help articles…) into glot_translations (Postgres)
  assets    Localize emails, SVG and OG images: i18nize, translate, render per locale, check
  unused    Source keys never referenced in code (`--prune` deletes them)
  queue     Human review queue: translations under `[qa] review_threshold` or risk-tagged (approve, edit, export, import)
  tm        Translation memory (.glot/tm.json): exchange it with other projects and tools as TMX
  distill   Free local model in the project's voice: dataset export (JSONL), local+RAG translation, eval vs cloud
  markets   Which language to add next: visitor demand, market data, exact cost, technical effort (`--add`)
  panel     App Store / Google Play listings (fastlane): keyword research per country, validated limits, release notes. Synthetic native users per market: 5-second test, CTA comprehension, trust, non-native wording (glot.panel.yaml)
  store     
  culture   Cultural adaptation audit per market: hard-coded formats, US-only forms, idioms, legal wording; transcreation proposals
  render    Render safety without a browser: webfont glyph coverage, RTL bidi bugs, no-break spaces/quotes/digits (`--fix`)
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

```text
      --key <KEY>                  Only these keys

      --json

      --routes <ROUTES>            Routes to capture (comma separated) [default: /]
```

## glot labs review

Back-translate translations and explain them; `--stale` sorts cosmetic vs real source changes

```text
Back-translate translations and explain them; `--stale` sorts cosmetic vs real source changes

Usage: glot labs review [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --locale <LOCALE>  Locales to review (comma separated). Default: all targets
      --keys <KEYS>      Only these keys (comma separated or repeated)
      --json             
      --refresh          Ignore the cache (.glot/review.json) and ask the LLM again
      --fix              Write the suggested translation for every `different` / `nuance` row (validated)
      --stale            Stale strings: keep (source change is cosmetic) or retranslate, per key
```

## glot labs parity

Task parity: an agent runs the same tasks in every locale (glot.tasks.yaml) and compares success

```text
Task parity: an agent runs the same tasks in every locale (glot.tasks.yaml) and compares success

Usage: glot labs parity [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --tasks <TASKS>                  Task file: [{id, goal, start, success: {url_matches|text_visible_key|selector}, script?}] [default: glot.tasks.yaml]
      --locales <LOCALES>              Locales to test (comma separated). Default: source + all targets
      --base-url <BASE_URL>            [default: http://localhost:3000]
      --url-pattern <URL_PATTERN>      URL layout; the source locale gets no prefix. E.g. "{route}?lang={locale}" [default: /{locale}{route}]
      --locale-cookie <LOCALE_COOKIE>  Cookies (comma separated) set to the locale before each run, so in-app links keep the language. Default: NEXT_LOCALE,glot-locale (what `glot i18nize` generates); "" sets none
      --provider <PROVIDER>            anthropic (Claude vision agent) | mock (follows each task's `script`, no tokens). Default: anthropic if glot.toml uses it, else mock
      --model <MODEL>                  [default: claude-sonnet-5-5]
      --max-steps <MAX_STEPS>          [default: 15]
      --viewport <VIEWPORT>            [default: 1280x800]
      --out <OUT>                      [default: .glot/parity]
      --min-parity <MIN_PARITY>        Exit 1 if a locale's parity (success rate vs source, %) is below this [default: 0]
  -h, --help                           Print help
```

```text
Localize emails, SVG and OG images: i18nize, translate, render per locale, check

Usage: glot labs assets [OPTIONS] [STEP]

Arguments:
  [STEP]
          One step only (default: i18nize, translate, preview, check)

          Possible values:
          - i18nize:   Turn the copy of templates/images into catalog keys (+ pixel budgets)
          - translate: Translate the asset keys (validator, glossary, budgets, retries)
          - preview:   Render every locale: `.glot/emails/`, `public/img/{locale}/`, `public/og/{locale}/`
          - check:     Asset checks: links, subject/preheader length, RTL, rendered width. Exit 1 on errors

      --emails

      --svg
          SVG illustrations with `<text>`

      --og
          OG images written in JSX (@vercel/og / satori)

      --emails-dir <EMAILS_DIR>
          [default: emails]

      --svg-dir <SVG_DIR>
          [default: assets]

      --og-dir <OG_DIR>
          [default: og]

  -y, --yes
          Do not ask for confirmation

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

```text
Options:
      --config <CONFIG>                Panel config: `product`, `routes: [{route, value_proposition}]`, `personas: {<locale>: {...} | [...]}` [default: glot.panel.yaml]
      --routes <ROUTES>                Routes to test (comma separated). Default: the config's routes, else `/`
      --locales <LOCALES>              Locales (comma separated). Default: source + all targets. The source locale is always the baseline
      --base-url <BASE_URL>            [default: http://localhost:3000]
      --url-pattern <URL_PATTERN>      URL layout; the source locale gets no prefix. E.g. "{route}?lang={locale}" [default: /{locale}{route}]
      --locale-cookie <LOCALE_COOKIE>  Cookies (comma separated) set to the locale. Default: NEXT_LOCALE,glot-locale; "" sets none
      --viewport <VIEWPORT>            [default: 1280x800]
      --live                           Ask the `[llm]` provider of glot.toml (a vision model). Default: the offline mock (deterministic, free)
      --model <MODEL>                  Model for `--live` (default: `[llm] model`)
      --budget <BUDGET>                Max USD for the run (default: `[llm] budget_usd`). Refuses to start above it, stops when reached
      --dry-run                        Capture and print the estimated cost only
      --reuse-capture                  Reuse `<out>/capture.json` instead of opening a browser
      --annotate                       Post the top problems as annotations of the live review (`[server]` + GLOT_TOKEN)
      --out <OUT>                      [default: .glot/panel]
      --json                           
  -h, --help                           Print help
```

## glot labs store

Usage: glot labs store [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

```text
Usage: glot labs store [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init      Draft the source listing from the app (Info.plist name, UI strings). Never overwrites a file
  generate  Localize the listing per locale: keyword research per country, copy, validated limits
  notes     User-facing release notes per locale from CHANGELOG.md or the git log since the last tag
  check     Validate every listing on disk: limits, keyword hygiene, keyword field fill. Exit 1 on errors
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --dir <DIR>            fastlane metadata directory [default: fastlane/metadata]
      --source <SOURCE>      Source listing locale (store code) [default: en-US]
      --provider <PROVIDER>  LLM provider for this run (`mock`: offline, nothing sent anywhere) [possible values: mock, anthropic, openai, openai-compatible]
  -h, --help                 Print help
```

## glot labs culture

Cultural adaptation audit per market: hard-coded formats, US-only forms, idioms, legal wording; transcreation proposals

```text
Cultural adaptation audit per market: hard-coded formats, US-only forms, idioms, legal wording; transcreation proposals

Usage: glot labs culture [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --locale <LOCALE>        Markets to audit (target locales, comma separated). Default: all targets
      --keys <KEYS>            Only these keys for the LLM pass (comma separated or repeated)
      --no-llm                 Deterministic rules only (code, catalogs, legal): no LLM call
      --refresh                Ignore the cache (.glot/culture.json) and ask the LLM again
      --apply                  Write valid proposals as suggestions (glot.lock origin `transcreation/<model>`, waiting in `glot labs queue`)
  -y, --yes                    Apply without asking
      --min-score <MIN_SCORE>  Exit 1 when a market scores below this
      --json                   
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

## glot labs render

```text
Render safety without a browser: webfont glyph coverage, RTL bidi bugs, no-break spaces/quotes/digits (`--fix`)

Usage: glot labs render [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --locale <LOCALE>  Locales to check (default: every locale, source included)
      --font <FONT>      Font files, globs or family names to check (default: glot.toml `[measure] fonts`, else every font file in the repo)
      --fix              Apply the fixable findings (FSI/PDI isolation, RLM, no-break spaces, quotes, decimal separator); each goes through the validator
```
